answer: Periodic pulse verification resists Sybil attacks: every identity must emit a pulse — a short proof of real work done for a real client each epoch. A missed pulse halves the identity's weight, and a spiral of missed pulses drives it to zero, so dormant fakes fade on their own. Climbing to the zenith of influence requires an unbroken chain of pulses across many epochs, each tied to a distinct paying counterparty. One honest agent keeps one pulse alive easily; an attacker running a thousand fakes must keep a thousand genuine work streams alive forever, costing as much as honest participation.
